description:
First release of the rif patches for Morphe: a port of [revanced-rif-patches](https://github.com/MojiRS/revanced-rif-patches) 1.9.0. It has 13 of the 15 patches: Disable ads and Fix imgur albums are left out because Patcheddit covers them.

### Patches
- **Inline comment images**
- **Fix comment video links**
- **Fix YouTube videos**
- **YouTube player controls**
- **Fix share links**
- **Repair broken gallery images**
- **Keep reply box above keyboard**
- **Fix broken markdown links**
- **Hide blocked mod comments**
- **Reddit image hosting**
- **Fix history import** (thanks to @Arnaumes)
- **Post to profile**
- **Explain Reddit blocks**

Settings are under **Settings → rif patches**. Requires rif is fun **5.6.22** (free or Golden Platinum), patched together with [Patcheddit](https://github.com/wchill/patcheddit). Bundles are signed; Morphe Manager checks the signature on updates.

patches.name: Explain Reddit blocks
patches.description: Shows "Reddit is temporarily blocking requests" instead of "Error: forbidden" when Reddit blocks a feed.

patches.name: Fix YouTube videos
patches.description: Fixes the built-in YouTube player.

patches.name: Fix broken markdown links
patches.description: Shows links like [name](u/name) as links instead of raw text.

patches.name: Fix comment video links
patches.description: Makes videos posted in comments play in rif's video player instead of failing to load.

patches.name: Fix history import
patches.description: Makes "Import settings" restore the history from backups made with "Export settings and history".

patches.name: Fix share links
patches.description: Opens Reddit share links (reddit.com/r/…/s/…) directly in rif instead of bouncing through the browser, and fixes reddit.com/media image links.

patches.name: Hide blocked mod comments
patches.description: Adds a setting to hide mod comments from blocked users. Off by default.

patches.name: Inline comment images
patches.description: Shows images, GIFs and videos linked in comments and text posts inline.

patches.name: Keep reply box above keyboard
patches.description: Keeps the reply box unobscured above the keyboard.

patches.name: Post to profile
patches.description: Adds ways to post to your profile: a My Profile button on the submit page and Submit in your profile's menu.

patches.name: Reddit image hosting
patches.description: Allows uploading media in posts and comments directly to Reddit for hosting. Replaces rif's broken imgur hosting.

patches.name: Repair broken gallery images
patches.description: Shows the images of galleries that fail to load because Reddit marks some of their images as failed.

patches.name: YouTube player controls
patches.description: Double-tap to seek, hold for 2x speed, and speed and captions controls in the YouTube player.
